question: In February 2022, where was India's first Biosafety Level-3 Mobile Laboratory inaugurated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India's first Biosafety Level-3 Mobile Laboratory** was inaugurated in **Maharashtra** in February 2022.
 
• The laboratory aims to** investigate emerging viral infections** that are highly infectious and pose a significant threat to public health.
 
• Equipped with advanced testing and diagnostic facilities, the mobile lab can be deployed to remote areas to conduct on-site testing and research.
 
• This initiative is part of India's ongoing efforts to enhance its ability to respond to biological threats and improve public health infrastructure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Biosafety Level-3 (BSL-3) laboratories are designed to work with infectious agents that may cause serious or potentially lethal diseases through inhalation.
 
• Such laboratories have stringent safety protocols and containment measures to prevent the release of pathogens into the environment.
 
• The mobile laboratory in Maharashtra is a significant step towards bolstering India's capacity to handle biothreats and conduct crucial research in virology.
 
• **BSL-3 labs** are essential for diagnosing and researching diseases like** tuberculosis, SARS, COVID-19**, and other viral hemorrhagic fevers.
